text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute has drawn within arm's
reach of the
peak she's been aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, puff, puff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's reached out and brushed her
fingers against
it.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falco! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I ran so hard I can barely stand, but
Falco... How
is she smiling like that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sigh... She's incredible. It doesn't matter whether I win or lose...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I could never shine as bright as she does.
I guess
some Umamusume are just
destined for more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Great job out there, Acute! ☆ But we're
not done
yet!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The concert stage is still waiting for us!
It's just as
important as the race, you
know. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Still, there's no way I can
command
the stage like you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hope you won't mind if I go for
something more
understated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silver and gold may not shine with the
same
luster, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute never fails to do what
needs to be
done, whether it's on the
track or the stage.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, dearie. With this race, I've
officially
been on TV. Thanks to that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I bet I was able to cheer up all the old
folks and
the people at the gym. They
must've seen that
hard work and
determination can get them back
on
their feet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hope so. Still, there sure is quite the
distance
between Falco and me. She was
like a ferocious
beast out there.
choice_data_list: ああ、多分示せたと思う！
うん、多分示せたと思う！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I think we proved it!
Yeah, I think we really showed them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's exactly right. The distance
between her and
Smart Falcon, the
current queen of dirt racing, is
nothing
to sneeze at.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to race her one more
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, Falco told me something
after the
race today...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Acute! I better see you there on
stage
with me next time too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And it'll be my first time performing in

Kawasaki! ♪ Our fans are waiting!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: By Kawasaki, do you think she meant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can assume she was referring to
Kawasaki
Racecourse. As for G1 races
held there...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The Kawasaki Kinen, huh? ...Well, shall
we make
an appearance?
choice_data_list_en: Probably the Kawasaki Kinen in early February.
Probably the Kawasaki Kinen in early February, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think if I can run the same way I did
today,
everyone would have to agree
that I've caught up
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't sound like she's really
planning to give
Falco a run for her
money...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I get the sense that's enough for
her. I guess
Umamusume run for all sorts
of reasons.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I would say I'm counting on you for
training...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I think we can probably take it easy
for a
while. Besides, it's the end of the
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like she's in the holiday mood
already. I
agree that Wonder Acute
should be fine taking it
easy through
New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll leave next year... to next year. We
can think
about how we'll deal with
Kawasaki Kinen later.
